CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chats" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"title" text NOT NULL,
	"icon" text,
	"description" text,
	"pinned" boolean DEFAULT false,
	"archived" boolean DEFAULT false,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	"updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	"total_tokens" integer DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conversations" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"chat_id" text NOT NULL,
	"model_id" text,
	"total_tokens" integer DEFAULT 0,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	"updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "messages" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"conversation_id" text NOT NULL,
	"model_id" text,
	"role" text NOT NULL,
	"content" text NOT NULL,
	"prompt_tokens" integer DEFAULT 0,
	"completion_tokens" integer DEFAULT 0,
	"total_tokens" integer DEFAULT 0,
	"favorite" boolean DEFAULT false,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "models" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"name" text NOT NULL,
	"service" text NOT NULL,
	"context" integer NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"name" text NOT NULL,
	"color_hex" text NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT "tags_name_unique" UNIQUE("name")
);
ALTER TABLE "chat_tags" ADD CONSTRAINT "chat_tags_chat_id_chats_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("chat_id") REFERENCES "public"."chats"("id") ON DELETE cascade ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE "chat_tags" ADD CONSTRAINT "chat_tags_tag_id_tags_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("tag_id") REFERENCES "public"."tags"("id") ON DELETE cascade ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE "conversations" ADD CONSTRAINT "conversations_chat_id_chats_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("chat_id") REFERENCES "public"."chats"("id") ON DELETE cascade ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE "conversations" ADD CONSTRAINT "conversations_model_id_models_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("model_id") REFERENCES "public"."models"("id") ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE "messages" ADD CONSTRAINT "messages_conversation_id_conversations_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("conversation_id") REFERENCES "public"."conversations"("id") ON DELETE cascade ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE "messages" ADD CONSTRAINT "messages_model_id_models_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("model_id") REFERENCES "public"."models"("id") ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;
